skill.name: video-edit
skill.description: Chooses a RunComfy video model for restyling, background and packaging changes, outfit edits, or motion transfer. It submits the prompt and media URLs through the RunComfy CLI.
skill.summary: Select a RunComfy model to restyle a clip or transfer motion from a reference video.
skill.author: prime-skills

security_audit.summary: The flagged backticks, example URLs, credential storage, and editing advice do not show command substitution, path traversal, unauthorized file access, or system reconnaissance. The skill recommends unpinned global installs, shows shell examples without safe argument handling for dynamic input, and lacks a confirmation step before remote media processing. No evidence of malicious intent or prompt injection was found in the reviewed file.

remediation.issue: The global CLI installation does not specify a package version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed CLI version. Ask before installation and prefer a project-local setup over a global install.

remediation.issue: The global skill installation points to an unpinned repository different from the reviewed source.
remediation.suggestion: Publish installation instructions for the exact reviewed revision. Use project scope by default and require explicit approval for global installation.

remediation.issue: The input safety claim does not cover the shell that launches the CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Serialize the payload with a JSON encoder and pass it through an argument array without a shell. Pass the output directory as a separate argument.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not require authorization before remote media processing.
remediation.suggestion: Identify RunComfy as the recipient and confirm which prompts and media links may be sent. Do not submit private media without approval.

content.user_title: Edit and Restyle Videos with RunComfy
content.value_statement: Background changes, outfit edits, and motion transfer need different models and inputs. This skill selects a RunComfy model and prepares the request for your edit.
actual_capabilities: Select Wan 2.7, Kling 2.6 Pro, or Lucy Edit Restyle based on the requested change.
Use Wan to restyle a clip, replace its background, or update packaging from a reference image.
Use Wan to request that the original audio be kept.
Use Kling to transfer motion from a reference video to a target character.
Use Lucy for local changes such as adjusting lighting or changing an outfit.
Submit jobs through the RunComfy CLI and download generated results to a selected directory.
limitations: Requires an authenticated RunComfy CLI and source media URLs that the service can access. Processing takes place on RunComfy servers.
Wan accepts MP4 or MOV clips lasting 2 to 10 seconds and up to 100 MB. Output is limited to 1080p.
Kling output is limited to 10 seconds with image orientation or 30 seconds with video orientation.
Lucy is limited to 720p and has no aspect ratio control. Each request uses one model.

use_cases.title: Update a Presentation Clip
use_cases.description: Replace a speaker's background with a neutral office and request that the original speech and lip movement be preserved.

use_cases.title: Preview New Packaging
use_cases.description: Apply an approved packaging design to a product clip while asking the model to keep the original framing and hand movement.

use_cases.title: Animate an Original Character
use_cases.description: Transfer motion from an approved performance recording to a character image to explore timing and movement.

prompt_templates.title: Change the Lighting
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Change one part of a short clip.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Lucy to give [video URL] warm evening light. Keep the subject's face, pose, and movement.

prompt_templates.title: Replace a Speaker Background
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: Set visual and audio preservation goals.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wan to replace the background in [video URL] with a neutral office. Keep the speaker's face, lip movement, framing, and original audio.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Packaging Reference
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Use an image to guide a targeted edit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wan to replace the packaging in [video URL] with the design in [image URL]. Keep the original framing and hand movement. Request 1080p output.

prompt_templates.title: Transfer Choreography to a Character
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Combine a character image with a motion reference video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Kling with image orientation to transfer motion from [reference video URL] to [character image URL]. Keep the character on the left. Omit reference audio.

output_examples.input: Replace the background of an eight-second speaker clip and keep its audio.
output_examples.output: Wan 2.7 is selected for the background edit. The result is downloaded to the chosen folder. The request preserves the original audio.

output_examples.input: Apply a dance reference to an original character image.
output: Kling 2.6 Pro is selected for motion transfer.
The character image sets the appearance, and the reference video supplies the motion.
Image orientation limits the generated clip to 10 seconds.

output_examples.input: Replace a jacket in a walking clip without changing the person's face.
output_examples.output: Lucy Edit Restyle is selected for the outfit change. The request asks it to retain the face and movement. Output is limited to 720p.

best_practices: State what must stay the same before describing one requested change.
Check the model's input format and duration limits before submitting.
Confirm that you may send the selected clips and references to RunComfy.
anti_patterns: Bundle a background swap, outfit change, and color grade into one request.
Choose a restyle model when the task is to copy motion from another clip.
Send confidential footage or private links without approval for external processing.

faq.question: Which model replaces a video background?
faq.answer: Wan 2.7 is the default for background replacement. Lucy is an alternative for a simple local restyle at 720p.

faq.question: Can I keep the original audio?
faq.answer: Yes. Wan has an option to retain the source audio. Kling can retain sound from the motion reference video.

faq.question: Can I edit a local file without uploading it?
faq.answer: The documented workflow requires a media URL that RunComfy can fetch. It does not support offline editing.

faq.question: Can I transfer movement from a different clip?
faq.answer: Yes. Kling uses a reference video to drive motion for a target character. Image orientation requires a target image.

faq.question: Can I use multiple models in one request?
faq.answer: No. The skill selects one model per request.

faq.question: What accounts or tools do I need?
faq.answer: You need the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and media URLs. Authentication uses CLI login or a RunComfy token.
